title: Recompute what arrives with content
statement: Never trust a pass label or measured value that arrives with content, such as a certification, a length, a reading level or a verbatim flag; recompute it on arrival.
example: A 12-row pilot certified as passing on every row came out 6 pass and 6 fail on local structural checks.
detail: A review of another reading project's proxy test found it trusted the generator's own word counts and reading levels and a 30-character substring check for verbatim spans, which paraphrase defeats; the action adopted was to recompute them at intake and treat any self-reported field used as a gate as unverified (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0072-learnings-from-incept-map-proxy-2026-06-25.qmd`). A received Grade 5 pilot of 12 rows carried embedded certification of pass for anti-leak and MAP-likeness on every row, yet local structural checks passed 6 and failed 6, and an independent passage-blind check was still required (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0067-g5-generator-pilot-intake-and-team-async-2026-06-23.qmd`).

evidence.quote: `word_count`/Lexile and a 30-char substring "verbatim" check (defeated by paraphrase).
any self-reported field used as a gate is UNVERIFIED.
has good surface shape (12 rows, all six formats, 920L, all RI.5.1, IB 0.98-1.00) but is not scale-ready: missing source_inventory/qa_report/generation_trace, local structural QA is 6 pass / 6 fail
Embedded certification says anti-leak/pass and MAP-likeness/pass for all rows.
Ready means checked. A block saved as ready with no judge call (before "unchecked" existed) is unchecked too.
Every item in the bank has passed a 14-dimension quality check at a ≥0.85 pass threshold before entering the operational bank.
| Dim 6: Passage word count | Length within 150–500w range (format-dependent) | Hard gate |
KNOWN CURRENT VIOLATION: all 460 bank passages are ~¼ target length
prod runs an interim 118-item bank until the C10-compliant rebuild.
a fresh render and independent probes confirm duration, frame size, module coverage, and an unchanged G9 working tree.

This was a re-review, so I verified all five of my prior findings independently - ran your gates myself, ran my own scanner on your passages - rather than trusting the disposition table. Then I swept for anything the fix wave introduced.
including Unit-1's June certifications, which had until then been carried forward. 63 items recovered (58 Unit-1 + 3 hot-text + 2 choice).
A source is not safe because a generator labeled it `verified`.
